subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum mentally filed Thorin's response under 'correct.'

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum tried to look modest about being singled out by the First Reader and mostly failed.
source_quote: I tried to look modest about this and mostly failed.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum felt in demand when Vareth reacted to him with intense recognition.
source_quote: I'm feeling, I said, to no one in particular, "in demand here."

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum knew the story of Stroud beating Protanther at chess because it had once comforted him.
source_quote: I know this story. I know it the way you know a story that someone told you when you were young and uncertain, when you needed proof that the impossible was occasionally available as an option.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum found the story of Stroud's chess win deeply comforting because it showed that preparation can still have blind spots.
source_quote: Four hundred years of preparation still has a blind spot.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum tested Vareth’s sincerity by stating the traditional expectation for Bahamut clerics.
source_quote: You have to understand, I said, with the measured cadence I use when I'm testing someone, "that it is traditional for clerics of Bahamut to want to try to take over the world. But I haven't moved into that phase yet."

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum finished Vareth’s thought by saying, "It truly was legendary."
source_quote: I felt it coming together and finished the thought for him: "It truly was legendary."

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum coined the term "Stroud's Gambit" because it had been sitting in the back of his mind since the journey began.
source_quote: And then, because I couldn't help it, and because the phrase had been sitting in the back of my mind since we started this journey and I'd never had the right audience for it: "Stroud's Gambit."

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum claimed that his conversion and behavior were all part of a plan.
source_quote: Oh," I said, as warmly as I could manage, "it's all part of the plan."

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum confirmed that Daz's habit of citing Malfire had become an ambient condition for the party.
source_quote: Yeah," I said, when someone turned to me for confirmation, "it's like we're kind of sick of each other, but somehow still together, yeah."

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum quoted Malfire in Volume 3 to end the conversation about Daz's citations.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum took notes because it's what he does.
source_quote: I took notes. It's what I do.

subject: Grygum's theological questions
fact: Grygum has unanswered questions about Bahamut's intentions and the meaning of his conversion, which remain unresolved.
source_quote: I didn't know what I was going to find. I had notes — the prayer book, the theological documents, the accumulated evidence of months in the Underdark — and I had questions...

subject: Grygum's journey
fact: Grygum carries the comfort of believing that sometimes the person who doesn't know what they're doing walks into the right room and everything clicks.
source_quote: I had the particular comfort of knowing that sometimes the person who doesn't know what they're doing walks into the right room and everything clicks.
